name: VUSE Student Hub

name: VUSM Cutting Edge
description: Cutting Edge is a student-run VUSM organization bringing the frontier of biomedical research to the medical school community.

name: VUSM Drug Policy Group

name: VUSM Music in Medicine

name: VUSM Non-Traditional Students Society (Formerly Methuselah Society)

name: VUSM Social Mission Committee

name: VUSM Student Wellness Committee
description: This is a student-run organization aimed at supporting Vanderbilt medical student wellness and to promote physical, mental, emotional, interpersonal, academic, and community health and wellbeing.

name: VUSM Student-Led Initiative for Disability Education
description: To educate medical students on the approach to disability, including topics such as physical exam, medical knowledge, referral practices, and social issues.

name: VUSM Students for a National Health Program Club

name: VUSM-MD International Medical Student Society
description: The VUSM International Student Society supports non-U.S. citizen medical students through tailored mentorship, community building, and professional development. Please note this organization is only open to current VUSM MD Students.

name: VUSN Asian Pacific Islander Desi American Student Nurses

name: VUSN Military and Veteran Student Affinity Group
description: The VUSN Military and Veteran Student Affinity Group is an organization formed to support those students at VUSN that are active duty military, veterans, and military spouses.

name: VUSN Pride

description: WMS is a group of medical students dedicated to advancing education in wilderness medicine through hands-on experiences of medical workshops, lectures, and outdoor activities.

description: Wilderness Skills is Vanderbilt University's premier outdoor experience.  The entirely student-run course consists of lectures on outdoor topics and weekend trips.  Trip activities include backpacking, rock climbing, caving, and whitewater paddling.

name: Women's Basketball
description: Women's Basketball at Vanderbilt

description: Vanderbilt Women's Club Lacrosse is a competitive club program comprised of skilled lacrosse players seeking a well-rounded college experience, blending academic, athletic, and social life.

name: Women's Club Water Polo

name: Women, Law, and Policy Program

name: Wond'ry Innovation Consulting Program
description: A nonprofit, volunteer, multidisciplinary graduate student consulting organization working with nonprofit, startup, and industry clients to solve significant problems in healthcare outcomes, management, operations, business strategy, and much more.

name: Writing Studio

name: WRVU Nashville
description: WRVU is a free-format college radio station committed to providing Vanderbilt University and the surrounding community with the best in new, non-mainstream music.

name: Youth Encouragement Services  - Vanderbilt
description: Y.E.S. Vanderbilt serves to promote and further the goals of the Nashville organization, Youth Encouragement Services, on Vanderbilt's campus. Y.E.S. Vanderbilt will further the organization’s mission by providing dedicated, dependable volunteers.

name: Zeta Beta Tau
description: An IFC Fraternity committed to the four pillars of its Credo-Brotherly Love, Intellectual Awareness, Integrity, and Social Responsibility-as well as its motto, "a Powerhouse of Excellence."

name: Zeta Phi Beta Sorority Inc.
description: To foster the ideas of service, charity, scholarship, civil and cultural endeavors, sisterhood and finer womanhood. These ideals are reflected in the sorority's national program for which its members and auxiliary groups provide voluntary service.

name: Zeta Tau Alpha
description: The Lambda Iota Chapter of Zeta Tau Alpha offers sisterhood, service, and leadership opportunities to our outstanding members. ZTA is the third largest Panhellenic sorority in the nation! Check out our Instagram page @vandyzeta to learn more!
